compositionIssues.detail: [composition/viewport-height] Preserve every node, relationship, and label. This 1080x1080 canvas (ratio 1) declares no intrinsic-height fit and is below the 1.55 wide ratio, so the desktop Reader can neither narrow it nor accept vertical scroll: it renders 1346px tall at the full 1346px width and the page reaches 1472px before cards against 900px, a certain visual-check failure. Either compact vertical spacing so meta.viewBox height is at most 696 at this width, or spread content sideways so the width is at least 1674 at this height; for architecture, omitting meta.viewBox lets the renderer size the canvas and declare the fit.

diagnostics.message: The rendered artifact overflows the 1440x900 light viewport.

evidence.pageCompositionMeasurement: CSS pixels at this viewport; body padding, header, diagram chrome, SVG and cards stack vertically and sum to scrollHeight

supportedFixes: the page is 731px too tall (12px body padding + 52px header + 78px diagram chrome + 1346px SVG + 143px cards = 1631px against 900px); the SVG spans the full 1346px reader width because its viewBox ratio is below 1.55 and it declares no intrinsic-height fit, so the Reader can neither narrow it nor accept readable vertical scroll: either remove meta.viewBox so the renderer sizes the canvas and declares the fit, or make the viewBox at least 1.55x wider than tall
